name: GenerateRandomNumber
label: Generate Random Number
description: Generates a random number or list of numbers within a specified range.

fields.name: MinimumValue
fields.label: Minimum Value
fields.description: The lower boundary for the random number(s) to generate.

fields.name: MaximumValue
fields.label: Maximum Value
fields.description: The upper boundary for the random number(s) to generate.

fields.name: GenerateMultipleNumbers
fields.label: Generate Multiple Numbers
fields.description: Specify whether to generate a single number or multiple numbers.

fields.name: HowManyNumbers
fields.label: How Many Numbers
fields.description: Specify how many random numbers to generate.

fields.name: AllowDuplicates
fields.label: Allow Duplicates
fields.description: Specify whether to permit duplicate values in the generated list.

fields.name: RandomNumber
fields.label: Random Number Output
fields.description: The newly generated random number (for single mode).

fields.name: RandomNumbers
fields.label: Random Numbers List Output
fields.description: The newly generated list of random numbers (for multi-mode).
